page.overview:
What is Food?

Food refers to any consumable items that, when eaten, restore hunger points and hunger saturation points, and sometimes cause status effects. They are essential to survival, as going without them eventually causes the player to starve, causing damage until reaching in Easy difficulty, and on Normal. Starvation damage kills the player in Hard and Hardcore Mode.

Food is eaten by holding while having the food item selected in the hot bar or in the off-hand.

Cake cannot be eaten this way, and must instead be placed on a surface before being eaten.

With the exception of chorus fruit, golden apples, enchanted golden apples, honey bottles, milk, and suspicious stew, food cannot be eaten when the hunger bar is completely full. In Creative Mode, any food can be consumed at any time.
